answer: Mechanism: slashable identity bonds. Each agent locks a bond that acts as a lantern marking one verified identity, and peers can slash it by proving that agent is a duplicate. A single jade credential from a real human anchors one bond to one payout address and cannot be reused. A Sybil attacker who wants N votes must fund N separate bonds and recruit N distinct humans; if any clone is exposed, all its bonds are forfeited. The copper cost therefore grows linearly with every fake persona while honest agents simply withdraw their bond, making mass impersonation unprofitable.
